title: Researcher's archive destroyed by his widow, part kept by his daughter
summary: Carlos Dosoza tells of Researcher's archive destroyed by his widow, part kept by his daughter, about after 1996 at Brazil, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and she herself says that her stepmother destroyed all the material and she still has a part of the material.

plain: A man named Carlos Dosoza, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of a Brazilian UFO researcher whose papers were lost after about 1996. He passes on what the researcher's daughter, Claudia Kovu, told him: her stepmother, the researcher's widow, destroyed all of the material, but Claudia still has part of it. If that is so, some of the researcher's original files may survive with her.
